pr.title: feat(dcp): TP-104 scanner as direct CI gate (warn-only) + pre-commit + test_16 resolution
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds a direct scanner invocation step to `.github/workflows/ci-complete.yml`: reuses the existing `CHANGED_FILES` bash fragment from the root-hygiene step (no second fragment written); invocation `PYTHONPATH=src uv run --frozen python -m dopemux.dcp.red_lane_scanner --files $CHANGED_FILES --packet-id ci`; ships **warn-only** (exit 0 on findings, findings logged).
- Ships hand-authored `proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-104/APPROVAL.json` per design B.6 (workflow file edit).
- Resolves `test_16`: deselect removed; test converted to packet-context-only (skip-unless-anchor-matches guard) OR deleted with rationale recorded — implementer documents chosen approach in PROOF.json.
- Adds pre-commit staged-files entry running the scanner on staged files (advisory tier).

## Depends on
DMX-DCP-TOOLING-103 (--packet-id argparse required).

## Scope
CI workflow (warn-only), pre-commit (advisory), test_16 resolution. Scanner source not modified.

## NOT_RUN
Enforcing gate flip (follow-up after one green week). Live CI run on deliberate-violation branch.

steps.task: Resolve test_16 in tests/dcp/test_red_lane_scanner.py. Root cause: test diffs against TP-DCP-0002's packet base SHA — PR-context-sensitive, false-positives on workflow edits. Decision: either (a) convert to skip-unless-anchor-matches (add a pytest.mark.skipif checking for the anchor SHA in the environment — test only runs when the specific context is present) or (b) delete with a comment recording the rationale and the assertion that the direct CI scanner gate now provides the correct coverage. Record chosen approach in a code comment. Whichever approach: the -k 'not test_16' deselect in pyproject.toml or pytest.ini or the CI invocation must be removed. Per plan FEAS-10/SEC-5.
